m:dataSetInformation.common:name: Human toxicity non-cancer (inorganics)
m:dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: USEtox consensus multimedia model. It spans two spatial scales: continental scale consisting of six compartment (urban air, rural air, agricultural soil natural soil, freshwater, costal marine water), and the global scale with the same structure but without the urban air. Specific groups of chemicals requires further work
